brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.evidence: 3-piece base: piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full + piece:0,1,0;half-n provides portable footprint
3 removable bins: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments), bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments), bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-half-n-full-div3 (3 compartments) – all drop-in trays
handle:0,0,0;top mounted via cover:0,0,0;full;top and 3 inserts (60/180/300 deg) – Trinity-style handle for loaded carry; meshClash clear

finish.summary: Portable 3-cell organizer (2 full + 1 half-n) with 3 compartmented removable bins for small electronics parts, one south-facing drawer on the half base, and a top-mounted carry handle on the central full cell. All mesh checks clear.

lines.label: Bin, north half, full depth, 3 compartments
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
